messages:
AlexW: Heads-up — we need a hotfix cut for 1.10.9. Found a regression in header parsing that causes tokenization mismatch for some customers. Minimal diff only. Aiming to cut in ~30m. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/inference/pulls/4921 :exclamation:
PriyaM: Can we keep changelog to one line and bump patch only? I can add the single-line entry after the PR merges. :+1:
JoshL: I can take the version bump and the backport. Will open a tiny patch branch off release/1.10.x and cherry-pick.
AlexW: thanks — only include the regression fix and automated test that prevents the exact crash. No refactors or unrelated noise. If it's >5 files ping me.
JoshL: ack. plan:
```
# create branch
git checkout -b hotfix/1.10.9-tokenize-regress release/1.10.x
git cherry-pick -x <commit-ish>
# bump patch
npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore(release): 1.10.9"
```
EmilyR: FYI the integration test matrix takes ~6m in CI. I'll queue the run once the PR is up. If it fails, we probably need a hotfix followup rather than delaying the cutoff.
RyanK: Which services require coordinated deploys? runtime and api-proxy? I can hold the proxy window.
AlexW: runtime and api-proxy yes. Keep the deploy minimal — runtime first, then proxy with a 10m stagger. RyanK you're release approver if infra looks green.
PriyaM: changelog line: "fix: tokenization mismatch causing truncated prompts (hotfix)" — good?
JoshL: SGTM. PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/inference/pulls/4923 (branch hotfix/1.10.9-tokenize-regress). Includes test + package.json patch bump.
release-bot: CI status — hotfix/1.10.9-tokenize-regress: build queued -> running (job 4 of 8).
EmilyR: CI running smoke + integration now. Will post results.
PriyaM: reminder to include the commit SHA in the changelog entry and add the issue number if you can. Keeps release notes traceable.
JoshL: CI green on unit + smoke. integration queued. Pushed changelog entry to PR description as requested.
release-bot: CI status — hotfix/1.10.9-tokenize-regress: all checks passed.
AlexW: Great. Cutting the tag in 5m unless any objections. Josh — once I tag, kick runtime deploy and ping here when the runtime is healthy.
JoshL: will tag and push: `git tag -a v1.10.9 -m "hotfix: tokenization mismatch" && git push origin v1.10.9`
RyanK: Ready on proxy. Standby for health check.
EmilyR: runtime smoke looks fine after deploy on staging. Canary on prod will be 2 nodes for 10m.
AlexW: Deploying now.
release-bot: Release created v1.10.9 by AlexW — https://releases.internal/redwood/1.10.9
RyanK: runtime healthy. proxy deploy starting.
PriyaM: changelog entry merged; single-line added to release notes.
JoshL: proxy up and healthy. No errors in 15m canary. Rolling to remaining nodes.
AlexW: Closing cutoff. Thanks everyone — we'll monitor post-deploy for 2 hours. If anything pops up, open a new thread but call me. :thumbsup:
EmilyR: I'll keep watch on error budget and signal any regressions.
AlexW: tagging postmortem placeholder: tracking/1.10.9-hotfix-monitoring (will fill if needed).
